overview: This single-page file consists of a “List of Papers” index for material concerning prisons and reformatories in the Kwantung Leased Territory. It records one item: an April 23 report, sent from Dairen by Grummon to the Embassy, on prison administration in the leased territory; the report itself is not present in the supplied text.

subfiles.summary: The page is a subject index headed “Prisons and Reformatories — Kwantung.” It lists one paper, dated April 23, from Dairen and associated with Grummon, described as a report on prison administration in the Kwantung Leased Territory. The underlying report is not included in the OCR supplied here, and its year is not stated.

interest: The page is useful chiefly as archival evidence that a substantive report on Kwantung prison administration once existed and was transmitted from the U.S. post at Dairen to the Embassy. Although it contains no prison statistics or administrative findings itself, it preserves the report’s subject, origin, approximate date, and filing context, which could help a historian locate the missing document elsewhere in State Department or embassy records.
